evidence: Preferences use a strict versioned schema with bounded reads, legacy language/detail migration and monotonic revision.
Writes acquire an atomic directory lock, reread inside the lock, merge one field and atomically rename a mode-0600 file inside a mode-0700 directory.
Malformed or oversized regular files are quarantined with a bounded diagnostic state; symlinks and non-regular files fail closed without touching targets.
Two real Node processes concurrently update separate fields and both values survive with revision 2.
Controller performs durable remembered updates before publishing saved state; session-only details remain in memory.
